{
  "table": {
    "name": "Match",
    "purpose": "One row per soccer (football) match: teams, league, season, date, final score, player lineups with pitch coordinates, detailed match event XML, and pre-match betting odds from multiple bookmakers. This is the central fact table of a European soccer database (Kaggle \"European Soccer Database\" layout)."
  },

    "col_004": {"role": "category", "name": "season", "description": "Season label in 'YYYY/YYYY' format, 2008/2009 through 2015/2016 (8 seasons).", "status": "resolved"},
